subject.title: Proposal: unify credential access policy across providers

question: Should CodexBar adopt the proposed provider-neutral Standard/No prompts/Disabled policy, and should Standard continue launching credential-capable provider tools automatically until a denial or containment event occurs?
rationale: Source and history confirm reusable host boundaries but do not establish the intended user contract, compatibility semantics, or acceptable limits on child-process behavior; those choices affect security claims, defaults, and multiple providers.

options.title: Adopt incrementally, compatibility first
options.body: Create a shared policy and broker in stages while preserving current Standard automatic refresh behavior until each credential boundary is migrated and proven.

options.title: Require explicit credential-capable launches
options.body: Adopt the shared policy but make credential-capable or unknown provider tools user-initiated by default, accepting reduced automatic refresh behavior.

options.title: Keep provider-specific policies
options.body: Continue fixing individual provider and credential-path bugs without adding a common user-facing policy or migration program.

recommendation.title: Adopt incrementally, compatibility first
recommendation.body: Create a shared policy and broker in stages while preserving current Standard automatic refresh behavior until each credential boundary is migrated and proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes CodexBar-wide settings, security language, provider behavior, and upgrade compatibility, making the repository owner the clearest decision owner.
